scope: D learner-content organization over accepted canonical Block/KP Core; no medical-Core duplication, no Projection/UI decisions
role: Realize the accepted canonical medical model through continuous Chat/content teaching, complete applicable answers, same-model compression and ordinary review; canonical Block Markdown remains the sole medical Core owner.
hard_rules: Original Lecture and visuals remain the evidence source for exact wording, decisive visual relations and explicitly Source-bound learning. Their local requirements and HOLD boundaries remain; they do not require a second continuous course or block ordinary Chat/content learning of accepted material.
Canonical Block Markdown remains the sole medical Core owner; this content owner references Core and may not fork or paraphrase a second medical truth.
Framework, detailed teaching, ordinary review and compression are views of one accepted medical model; none creates a second medical truth.
Canonical KP Core supports continuous teaching, full applicable exact answers, checking, repair and reference. KP storage boundaries do not impose serial lessons or mandatory rereading.
Logic Group is retrieval/local-closure structure and never creates a Source trip by itself.
Visual-required cognition must use real original-Source visual contact when first formed; text cannot certify a never-seen spatial model.
Source gaps/conflicts remain explicit and fail closed; Content may not repair them from model prior.
Content organization must not add hard prerequisites, inferred question membership, learner progress or UI geometry.

content_layers.ORIENTATION: accepted System/Block model + current medical question + natural title〔complete canonical Prompt〕 nodes + explicit scope/owner boundaries
content_layers.SOURCE_CONTACT: For chosen or locally required Source study, use accepted whole-Block/natural-Source-unit/integration mappings; original visual and exact-wording claims retain their local Source requirements.
content_layers.RETRIEVAL: Optional self-test of the same accepted model; ordinary teaching/review keeps full applicable answers available and imposes no fixed KP/LG quiz cadence.
content_layers.CORE_CHECK: Canonical KP Core supplies the same continuous model and full applicable Memory/Precision answers for teaching, ordinary review, checking and repair; medical truth remains in Block Markdown.
content_layers.BOUNDARY: Source gaps/conflicts, external-owner boundaries, deferred scope and exact precision remain explicit
content_layers.COMPRESSION: Block Recall and accepted optional PSR/System reconstruction compress already-built models; they do not replace first Source contact These are optional views of the same accepted model, available for ordinary review without requiring a serial closure ladder; formal full-coverage claims still need real coverage.
